<noinclude><pagequality level="3" user="Prosody" />{{rh|116|JOVE BODES THE TROJANS ILL|[{{smaller|ILIAD}}}}</noinclude>Jove boded them ill and roared with his portentous thunder. Pale fear got hold upon them, and they spilled the wine from their cups on to the ground, nor did any dare drink till he had made offerings to the most mighty son of Saturn. Then they laid themselves down to rest and enjoyed the boon of sleep.<noinclude></noinclude>
